name: Katepensaurus
sum: Katepensaurus is a rebbachisaurid sauropod from the Late Cretaceous Bajo Barreal Formation of Chubut, Argentina, known from a partial skeleton.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: UNPSJB-PV 1007, a partial skeleton from the Lower Member of the Bajo Barreal Formation.
material: Known from the holotype; other rebbachisaurid specimens from the formation may belong to it.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Ibiricu et al. 2013
